SEN. IMEE MARCOS WANTS PALACE REPORT ON TANTOCO DEATH

JUST IN: Sen. Imee Marcos is calling on Malacañang to disclose a full report on the March 8 death of Paolo Tantoco in Los Angeles, California — including any direct or indirect involvement of First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos.

Tantoco was part of the First Lady’s entourage during the Manila International Film Festival in LA from March 4 to 7. U.S. medical examiners ruled his death an accident due to “cocaine effects.” | via @hannaaahty, https://t.co/9R0Mcay5im
